title: XLS-0039: Clawback Support
key_points: Clawback feature allows issuers to recover issued assets under certain circumstances.
The feature is disabled by default and requires the issuer to have an empty owner directory before enabling it.
Issued tokens can be clawed back by an issuer if, and only if, lsfAllowTrustLineClawback flag is set.
limitations: This proposal deals only with issued assets. The proposed clawback support cannot be used to claw back XRP.
Introduces an additional transaction, along with the complexity that comes with that.
Issuers now get additional power, which may be concerning to token holders.
asserts: The XLS-0039 proposal introduces a clawback feature that allows issuers of digital assets in the XRP Ledger to recover issued assets under certain circumstances, enabling compliance with regulatory requirements.
